# Store the input file in $in.
storepath jj24kz6i96lk2arql8642d84zsp210mv-hello.txt
read in

# Build derivation.
[x86_64] [linux] storepath g02shnii7wnd4bq23v9ah92px0gl8w4f-hello-path.txt.drv
[aarch64] [linux] storepath wfc9gg6xnyqncxg8c3kdc0lvn9viymgj-hello-path.txt.drv
[aarch64] [macos] storepath nbdbgk8sbpla4w7q9ad50g82al7lyybk-hello-path.txt.drv
[x86_64] [windows] storepath ns9s9klhb0db6h99c8myc095k1hmi971-hello-path.txt.drv
read drvPath
realize $drvPath

# Check that output has the store path.
realpath $out
read realOut
grep $in $realOut

-- jj24kz6i96lk2arql8642d84zsp210mv-hello.txt --
Hello, World!
-- g02shnii7wnd4bq23v9ah92px0gl8w4f-hello-path.txt.drv --
